summary: The public-benchmark run completed an independently reconstructed CPS analogue before adding family conditioning, then estimated separately labeled family-post and family-month extensions on the same 468-occupation support. The annual 2022-to-2024 Q5-minus-Q1 growth-factor difference is -0.0346 with occupation-linearized interval [-0.1455, 0.0763]; the November-2022-to-June-2026 analogue is -0.2312 [-0.4660, 0.0036]. Every family-conditioned young-relative interval contains zero. The unavailable exact BCC membership remains explicit, and no Q5-Q1 inference is transferred to the top-two/bottom-three grouping.
